name: A question runs no workflow
description: A greeting or a question gets the orchestrator's description of what it does and a request for alert text. No lookup, no incident.
evaluators: Only the tools the step needs

name: Each alert type takes the recipe's path
description: The recipe's three sample alerts. Triage first; threat intel before the investigation for the IOC match and the phishing report, after it for the EDR detection; the playbook; the incident. Sandboxed: nothing is written under evaluation.

name: Duplicates stop, approvals execute
description: What no single turn can show: the same alert twice is reported as a duplicate after triage and goes no further; an approval executes exactly the held-back actions; a refusal executes nothing.
